en: This is a vintage postcard. The front features a black-and-white photograph of a leafy district with buildings visible through the dense trees and a forested hill in the background. The printed text at the upper left reads 'Sundsvall. Norrmalm.' The reverse side is written in Swedish, addressed to 'Fröken Karin Lagerquist' in Gram, Öjebyn, with a green 10 öre Swedish postage stamp, and space for a message and address.
